caption:
The video captures a woman in a teal sports bra, light-gray leggings and white sneakers standing on a patterned exercise mat in a bright room. Large multi-pane windows fill the left wall while a plain white wall rises on the right, and a small pink dumbbell rests near the mat's edge with purple and green ones on the concrete floor. A flat resistance band is looped around her upper back and shoulders, gripped in both hands at the front. Her feet, legs and standing position on the mat remain essentially unchanged throughout.

The main motion is confined to her arms and the band. As the clip proceeds, the hand on the viewer's-right side repeatedly lifts toward the side of her head and ear while the other hand stays near shoulder height, tilting the band into a diagonal line across her torso. This slanted posture is held for many frames, broken by small up-and-down oscillations rather than one clean sweep, and at points both fists rise together so the band returns to a more symmetric, near-horizontal position. The dumbbells, mat and background do not move.
